meta.title: MenuDesk — Operational intelligence for cafes & restaurants
meta.description: MenuDesk is operational intelligence for cafes, bakeries, and restaurants across Southeast Asia. Menu engineering, food cost tracking, and demand forecasting — coming Q3 2026.

hero.title: Operational intelligence for cafes, bakeries, and restaurants.
hero.subtitle: MenuDesk turns your POS data into a daily briefing — what's selling, what's costing you, and what to do about it. Built for Southeast Asia.
hero.feature1Desc: Know your stars, dogs, puzzles, and plowhorses. Price and position with confidence.
hero.feature2Desc: Recipe-level cost monitoring as ingredient prices move. No more month-end surprises.
hero.feature3Desc: Prep the right amount, staff the right shifts. Less waste, fewer 86s.
